name: United States
public_goal: Maintain secure access to lunar resources and protect allied activities.
hidden_goal: Prevent China from achieving dominant control over lunar south-pole infrastructure.
style: Strategic, competitive, alliance-oriented, willing to cooperate when it protects long-term influence.

name: China
public_goal: Secure stable access to lunar resources for long-term peaceful development.
hidden_goal: Achieve strategic parity or superiority in critical lunar infrastructure.
style: Long-term planning, sovereignty-sensitive, cautious about dependency on rival blocs.

name: Japan
public_goal: Promote safe, sustainable, and cooperative lunar development.
hidden_goal: Become indispensable to both major powers by providing shared infrastructure and trusted services.
style: Consensus-oriented, technically pragmatic, focused on mediation and common infrastructure.
